disturb the peace: The neighbors called the police because the loud party was disturbing the peace late at night.
鄰居報了警，因為那場吵鬧的派對在深夜擾亂安寧。
disturb the balance: Bringing foreign fish into the lake may disturb the balance of the local ecosystem.
把外來魚種引進湖裡可能會破壞當地生態系的平衡。
be disturbed by the news: Many parents were disturbed by the news that a stranger had been seen near the school gate.
許多家長對有陌生人在校門附近出沒的消息感到不安。
do not disturb: The hotel guest hung a "Do not disturb" sign on her door because she wanted to sleep late.
那位飯店房客在門上掛了「請勿打擾」的牌子，因為她想睡晚一點。
ditch the plan: When it started raining heavily, we decided to ditch the plan for a picnic and watched a movie instead.
雨開始下很大時，我們決定放棄野餐計畫，改成看電影。
ditch a friend: It's not nice to ditch a friend at a party just because you met someone more popular.
只因為遇到更受歡迎的人就在派對上甩掉朋友，這樣不太好。
ditch school: Tom ditched school to play video games at an internet café, and his parents were furious.
湯姆翹課去網咖打電動，他的父母氣壞了。
ditch the car: When the road was blocked by snow, we had to ditch the car and walk the last two kilometers home.
道路被雪擋住時，我們只好丟下車子，走最後兩公里回家。
prices dived: Housing prices dived after the bank raised interest rates sharply, and many owners lost money.
銀行大幅升息之後，房價暴跌，許多屋主都賠了錢。
dive into work: As soon as she got back from vacation, she had to dive into work and answer hundreds of emails.
她一度假回來就得一頭栽進工作，回覆好幾百封電子郵件。
dive for cover: When the sudden hailstorm hit the stadium, fans dived for cover under the roof of the stands.
突如其來的冰雹襲擊體育場時，球迷們紛紛撲到看台的屋頂下掩蔽。
take a dive: Sales of the phone took a dive after reports said that its battery could catch fire.
有報導指出那款手機的電池可能起火後，它的銷量就暴跌了。
divide opinion: The new school uniform policy has divided opinion among students, with some loving it and others hating it.
新的校服政策在學生之間引起意見分歧，有些人很喜歡，有些人很討厭。
divide the work: To finish the project on time, the four of us decided to divide the work equally.
為了準時完成專題，我們四個人決定平均分工。
divide and rule: The colonial government used a divide and rule policy, setting different groups against each other to stay in power.
殖民政府採取分而治之的政策，挑撥不同群體互相對立以維持權力。
the issue divides the nation: The issue of nuclear power divides the nation, and people argue about it before every election.
核能議題撕裂國家，每次選舉前人們都為此爭論不休。
divide 10 by 2: If you divide 10 by 2, you get 5, which is the number of apples each child will receive.
如果十除以二，你會得到五，也就是每個孩子會分到的蘋果數量。
be divorced from reality: Some of the politician's promises seem divorced from reality, since the city simply doesn't have that much money.
那位政治人物的一些承諾似乎脫離現實，因為市政府根本沒有那麼多錢。
divorce theory from practice: Good teachers never divorce theory from practice; they always show students how ideas work in real life.
好老師從不讓理論與實務脫節；他們總是讓學生看到觀念如何在現實生活中運作。
get divorced: His parents got divorced when he was ten, but they still celebrate his birthday together every year.
他的父母在他十歲時離婚了，但他們每年仍一起為他慶生。
dock pay: The factory will dock pay from any worker who leaves the production line without permission.
工廠會扣任何未經許可離開生產線的工人的薪水。
the ship docked: After a ten-day voyage, the ship finally docked beside the pier, and tired passengers hurried off with their bags.
經過十天的航行，船終於在碼頭邊靠岸，疲憊的乘客提著行李匆忙下船。
dock points: Our English teacher will dock points for every spelling mistake, so check your essay carefully before handing it in.
我們的英文老師每拼錯一個字就會扣分，所以交作文前要仔細檢查。
in the dock: The businessman found himself in the dock, accused of cheating thousands of people out of their savings.
這名商人站上被告席受審，被控騙走數千人的積蓄。
document the process: The students used their phones to document the process of building the robot, step by step.
學生們用手機一步一步記錄建造機器人的過程。
well documented: The health risks of smoking are well documented in hundreds of scientific studies.
吸菸對健康的危害在數百份科學研究中都有詳細記載。
document evidence: The police carefully documented evidence at the crime scene by taking photos and writing detailed notes.
警方在犯罪現場拍照並寫下詳細筆記，仔細地以文件記錄證據。
dodge a question: When the reporter asked about the missing money, the mayor tried to dodge the question by changing the subject.
記者問到失蹤的錢時，市長試圖轉移話題來迴避問題。
dodge taxes: The rich businessman was arrested for hiding money in overseas bank accounts to dodge taxes.
那位富商因為把錢藏在海外銀行帳戶以逃稅而被捕。
dodge responsibility: Instead of admitting his mistake, the manager tried to dodge responsibility by blaming his team.
經理沒有承認錯誤，反而怪罪他的團隊來推卸責任。
dodge a bullet: I really dodged a bullet by not buying that car, because it broke down for its new owner a week later.
我沒買那輛車真是躲過一劫，因為一週後它就在新車主手上拋錨了。
